notes.title: 🛠️ ALPHA Demo - Patch 00.00.02 is live!
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback, we’ve made the first improvements to the TYRIUM ALPHA Demo:



✅ Order icons now include a simple confirmation animation

✅ Control layout in the game menu is now displayed correctly

✅ Building UI no longer shows the number of assigned builder bots

✅ Global sound volume setting added

✅ Rockets without a target no longer fly in circles (mostly 😉)





[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43806042/3526f34839501662944af666191be812be666686.gif"]







[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//43806042/a617066d15d4a130ba7406ed43319b2574f288f1.gif"]





This is just the beginning — more updates and improvements are on the way!



💬 Keep the feedback coming: 

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2329940/discussions/0/563626489222817911/





– Chris
